method: Manual post-draft review under protocols/writing-naturalness.md; changed claims checked against staged-calibration-contract.md, stage-two-execution-design.md, worker-095.R, stage-two validators, and the independent contract reconciliation.
coverage: All revised correction statements and the affected interpretation, consistency, and residual sections; historical campaign facts were read against the retained report and cited evidence locations.
score_reason: The correction uses explicit interval levels and states how the historical run is bounded. The required report structure is repetitive but clear.
confidence_reason: The protocol correction is supported by the controlling design and current worker/validator; the style rating remains subjective.

examples.cue: The revised text explicitly separates the historical fitted-profile run from the approved contract.
examples.impact: Readers can distinguish what the old run measured from what is needed for the current gate.
examples.quote: Preserve the original harness and build a separately pinned 97.5%-profile route after the interval contract was misread. This report now marks that route as historical; the approved current-source first look uses 95% fitted profiles and 97.5% Monte Carlo confidence intervals.

science_gate_reason: The revised statements use the reconciled 95% fitted-profile and 97.5% Monte Carlo levels and do not treat the 97.5%-profile run as current calibration.
facts_gate_reason: The specific contract claim was compared with the controlling design documents, current worker/validator behavior, and independent read-only reconciliation.
references_gate_reason: No external bibliographic claims were added; file paths identify internal project records.
calibration_status: Related interval-contract reports and the current source were already seen; no held-out style controls were used.
